steps.Weissman: No, my lord.{w}{br}We've searched the village, but the prince is nowhere to be found.

steps.Raydrik: You fool! We don't have much time. I know that the prince is here. Round up the villagers and make them talk! We need to find him!

steps.Weissman: Yes, we are already doing that, my lord.{w}{br}But the villagers say that he's not here.{br}He apparently left with the Fiana Freeblades, to go save some village from a pirate attack.

This village was originally the headquarters of a large group of brigands.{w}{br}A little over a decade ago, a travelling mercenary named Eyvel cleared out the bandits and took over the village.{br}She then stablished a militia to protect the nearby villages from bandit attacks.{br}Apparently she's quite skilled with her sword...

steps.Raydrik: Hmm.... She could be a problem.

steps.Weissman: No problem, my lord.{br}We've already taken Eyvel's daughter hostage.{br}We've also captured the daugther of Finn, the knight defending the prince.{w}{br}They'll have no choice but to give in to us now.

steps.Raydrik: Well, not bad, for you.{w}{br}Good, I shall take girls back to Manster with me.{br}You stay here and wait for the rebels.{w}{br}Make sure to capture the prince when he returns!
Ha! Stoutness is cute as well.{br}And the other...
Ah, so you're Finn's daughter..{w}{br}I understand your mother is a princess from Nordion.{w}{br}I see you haven't lost your dignity living in a place like this.
Well, I've gotten some pleasant surprises to take home with me.
Weissman, I'll now be returning to Manster.{w}{br}I trust you can handle the rest.

steps.Halvan: I'll go take a look, Lady Eyvel. Please wait here.
Lady Eyvel, the village is filled with imperial troops.{w}{br}It looks like the attacked while we were gone...

steps.Osian: What? Damn, those bastards! Lady Eyvel, let's go!

steps.Halvan: Calm down, Osian.{w}{br}If we run in there without planning, we'll be beaten down.
Why are you so calm, Halvan!? Our village is being attacked!

steps.Eyvel: No, Halvan is right. Calm yourself, Osian.
Lord Leif, it looks like the Empire has sought us out.{w}{br}please make your escape while we distract the imperial troops.

steps.Leif: Eyvel! Nanna's still in the village. I can't just leave her and run.

steps.Eyvel: I'll ensure her safety. Don't worry.

steps.Leif: No, that's not it... I've chosen not to run anymore.

steps.Eyvel: What about you Finn?{w}{br}Are you going to allow Lord Leif to get himself in danger?

steps.Finn: Lord Leif is already 15 years old.{w}{br}He's old enough to make his own decisions.{br}As his servant, I'll respect his judgement and follow his commands.

steps.Eyvel: 15... Well, we did bring him with us to defeat the pirates.{w}{br}Fine, if Finn says so, it's all right with me.

steps.Osian: Well, are we done? Let's hurry up and go kick their asses!

steps.Eyvel: Yes, but be careful. Although they are imperial troops, the lower-ranking ones are civilians forced into the army.{br}If you can, don't kill them, just take their weapons and let them escape. Understood?

steps.Osian: But we can hurt them until they submit to us, right?{w}{br}They will kill us if we don't.

steps.Eyvel: Yes, but don't overdo it, okay? Specially you, Osian.

steps.Osian: Come on, don't you trust me, Lady Eyvel?

steps.Eyvel: Okay, let's go. Show them the Fiana Freeblades' strength!

steps.Narrator: Barely escaping the burning of Castle Lenster with his life,{w}
young Prince Leif was looked after by Finn,{br}his last knight and retainer.{w}
Together with Finn's daughter, Nanna, the trio fled pursuers{w} sent by the conquerors of North Thracia: the Grannvale Empire,{w} which lay to the west.{w}
Yet Finn proved stronger than those who hunted them,{w} and the three made their way to the cities{w}
and Tahra, posing as common vagrants.{w}
Eventually, they drifted into Fiana,{w} a small village on Thracia's eastern coast.{w}
Fiana was an independent community with its own militia, the Fiana Freeblades,{w}
lead by the swordswoman Eyvel, who welcomed Leif's group{w} as if they were her own kin.{w}
Under her watchful eye, the deposed prince spent his childhood in Fiana,{w} growing into maturity alongside youths of common birth.{w}
But now, in the year 776 of the Grannvale Calendar...{w}

steps.Dagdar: Ain't no good way to go about this damned battle...{w}{br}Don't matter how good Eyvel is, there is only one of her an' over a dozen of them.{w}{br}We need to hurry.{w}

steps.Marty: Oh, fer cryin' out loud! Not again...{w}
